title: Claude Desktop / Claude Code MCP server configuration
description: Unofficial schema for claude_desktop_config.json's mcpServers block, based on Claude Code's documented config format. No official schema is published by Anthropic or SchemaStore as of this writing.

mcpServers.description: Map of server name -> server definition.

stdioServer.description: A locally-spawned server communicating over stdio. This is the default when no "type" is given.

command.description: Executable to run, e.g. "npx", "node", or an absolute path.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the spawned process.

remoteServer.description: A remote server reached over HTTP, SSE, or WebSocket.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with each request, e.g. Authorization.

oauth.description: OAuth configuration for servers that require it.
